untrustedWorkspaces.description: Ritemark renders markdown content via TipTap and does not execute code from the workspace.

ritemark.updates.mode.description: How extension updates are applied: 'auto' stages silently and relaunches on next start or click; 'prompt' shows the existing install notification. Full app updates are unaffected by this setting.

enumDescriptions: Receive updates only after they have been verified and published to everyone.
Receive extension updates as soon as they are published, before they reach everyone else. For pre-release verification only — a canary build has not yet been confirmed working.
ritemark.updates.channel.description: Which update ring to follow. Leave on 'stable' unless you are helping verify a release: 'canary' fetches an unverified pre-release update feed.

ritemark.analytics.enabled.description: Share anonymous usage data to improve Ritemark. On when you leave the welcome with its switch on; turn it off here or in Ritemark Settings. Never your documents, chats or names.

ritemark.features.voice-dictation.description: Voice dictation with Whisper on this computer (macOS and Windows). The first use downloads the speech model: 1.5 GB on Apple silicon, 834 MB on Windows and Intel Macs. Always on in current versions; this setting has no effect.

ritemark.features.agentic-assistant.description: Enable Claude in the AI sidebar (experimental). Allows autonomous file operations.

ritemark.features.codex-integration.description: Use ChatGPT in Ritemark, signed in with your ChatGPT account. Turn it off to hide ChatGPT.

ritemark.features.scheduled-flow-runs.description: Enable automatic scheduled execution for eligible flows (experimental). Runs only while Ritemark is open.

ritemark.features.analytics.description: Kill-switch for anonymous analytics. When disabled, no data is sent to PostHog.

ritemark.features.comment-callouts.description: Editor-only comments (#81): anchored highlights and /// notes, assignable to an AI agent. Kill-switch — disable if comments stop round-tripping.

ritemark.features.task-board.description: Task board (#119): a board per project folder with cards in .ritemark/tasks, Your calls, and Give to agent. Kill-switch — disable to hide the board and remove the board tools from agents.

ritemark.features.durableAgentConversati.description: Durable Agent Conversations: host-owned project history and the Conversations UI. After host cutover, disabling uses compatibility presentation without returning to legacy storage.

ritemark.features.composer-thinking-effo.description: Composer Thinking Effort: choose a model-supported effort for the next Agent Chat message. Kill-switch — disable to use provider defaults.

ritemark.features.transcribe-direct-reco.description: Transcribe recording: record from the microphone in the Transcribe panel. Kill-switch — disabling hides Record; recordings already saved stay ordinary files.

ritemark.features.powerpoint-preview.description: PowerPoint preview: open .pptx files as a read-only preview of their slides, drawn locally. Kill-switch — disabling shows a message with Open in PowerPoint instead.

enumDescriptions: Use the ChatGPT and Claude runtimes that ship inside Ritemark (recommended)
Prefer ChatGPT and Claude installed on this computer. The bundled ones are used only if none is found.
ritemark.agentRuntime.preference.description: Which agent runtime Ritemark prefers when both bundled and system installs are available. Applies to both ChatGPT and Claude.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every command and file change (safest)
Ask only for operations outside workspace boundaries
Auto-approve everything, ask only when a command fails
Never ask — run everything automatically (use with caution)
ritemark.codex.approvalPolicy.description: When ChatGPT should ask for your approval before running shell commands or modifying files.

enumDescriptions: ChatGPT can only read files (no writing or command execution)
ChatGPT can read and write files within the project (recommended)
Full system access including network — use with extreme caution
ritemark.codex.sandboxMode.description: What ChatGPT is allowed to do on your filesystem.

ritemark.opencode.autoApprove.description: Auto-approve OpenCode file edits and tool calls within the workspace without showing the approval card. Writes outside the workspace are still blocked. Use with caution.

enumDescriptions: Ritemark Agent - Chat assistant with RAG search and image generation
Claude (experimental) - Autonomous agent that can read, write, and organize files
ChatGPT (experimental) - OpenAI's agent, signed in with your ChatGPT account
ritemark.ai.selectedAgent.description: Select which AI agent to use in the sidebar

ritemark.ai.excludedFolders.description: Folders and file patterns Claude should not access. The agent is instructed to skip these paths.

ritemark.ai.selectedModel.description: Claude model for new chats. Empty uses Ritemark's recommended model; choosing a model in the AI sidebar saves it here.

ritemark.ai.debugTrace.description: Enable runtime trace logging for AI agents (written to temp directory). Restart required after changing.

ritemark.ai.hasSeenClaudeWelcome.description: Internal: tracks whether the Claude welcome wizard has been shown.

ritemark.chat.fontSize.description: Font size for AI chat interface (10-20px)

ritemark.ai.agentTimeout.description: Inactivity timeout for Claude in minutes (5-60). The agent will be stopped if it produces no activity for this duration.

ritemark.transcription.exportFolder.markdownDescription: Folder for exported transcripts, relative to the workspace root (or an absolute path). With no workspace open, transcripts are written beside the recording.

ritemark-robot.description: An agent, in New on Agents

ritemark-sparkle.description: A skill, in New on Agents

ritemark-command.description: A command, in New on Agents

colors.description: Ritemark 2.0: the ground, flat, under everything around the work.
Ritemark 2.0: the AI's sheet, between the ground and the desk.
Ritemark 2.0: the desk, the raised sheet the documents lie on.
Ritemark 2.0: the hairline around a sheet.

Ritemark 2.0: the shadow under what floats (menus, dialogs, quick input, the editor's toolbars), in ink in Light and black at 40% in Dark; high contrast draws none. The desk and the AI's sheet draw hairlines only (Sprint 142, #503; framework §4).
Ritemark 2.0: the fill behind the chosen place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Red, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Blue, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Green, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Yellow, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Purple, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Orange, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Pink, in the Agents place.
Ritemark 2.0: the icon of an agent whose settings chose Cyan, in the Agents place.
